The bowl looks like a large stainless mixing bowl, roughly 30 cm across. It appears to extend beyond the frame, and the visible part is about 400 px wide, which suggests a diameter of about 25-30 cm.

There are two small pizza pieces, each about 100 px by 140 px. If the bowl is about 28 cm across at roughly 14 px per cm, each piece is about 7 by 10 cm and about 1 cm thick. That gives about 70 cm³ per piece, but the pieces are thin, so I estimate about 45 g each, or about 90 g in total.

Two pepperoni slices are visible, each about 4 cm across, weighing about 3 g each. That adds up to about 6 g.

I counted the cheese and crust as one pizza item, and I listed the pepperoni separately.
